comment: Salt glazing is the one glaze with no coating step: salt is thrown into the kiln at peak temperature and the sodium vapour reacts with the silica in the body itself. So it is a kiln slot, not an applicator, and one handful glazes the whole load where lead needs a nugget per pot. Flagged by attribute rather than matched by item code so another mod's salt joins in with a one-line patch of its own.
